cohort: 95 healthy newborns who were born with normal spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD) or elective caesarean section (C/S) and who were not given prophylactic antibiotic eye drops after birth
finding: Culture positivity for S.aureus was higher in C/S compared to SVD, while CNS growth was significantly lower in the conjunctival cultures of neonates.
mod_finding: Culture positivity for S.aureus was higher in C/S compared to SVD, while CNS growth was significantly lower in the conjunctival cultures of neonates.
